evidence: M-O s.v. media, news media, after the Second Vatican Council and Egger
terms.comment: The Church’s term since the Second Vatican Council (Morgan–Owens): the instruments of social communication.

terms.gloss: the news media, those who spread the news
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens also gives nūntiōrum dīvulgātiō, the spreading of news.
A journalist is diurnārius (Traupman 167, 335), from diurna, the daily gazette (see newspaper).

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. media, news media.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 167, 335, 364, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
